name: UpdatePrivateAccessPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the internal network access policy. Get this value from one of the following operations:

- [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~): List internal network access policies in batches.

- [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~): Create an internal network access policy
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略ID。取值来源：
- [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~)：批量查询内网访问策略。
- [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~)：创建内网访问策略
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.example: 这是一条内网访问策略
parameters.help_en: A description of the internal network access policy. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The action that the internal network access policy takes. Valid values:

- **Block**: Block access.

- **Allow**: Allow access
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略动作。取值：
- **Block**：阻断。
- **Allow**：允许
parameters.name: policy_action

parameters.help_en:
The application type for the internal network access policy. Valid values:

- **Application**: Application.

- **Tag**: Tag
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略的应用类型。取值：
- **Application**：应用。
- **Tag**：标签
parameters.name: application_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of applications associated with the internal network access policy. A single policy supports up to 100 application IDs
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略的应用ID集合。一条策略最多支持100个内网访问应用ID
parameters.name: application_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of tags associated with the internal network access policy. A single policy supports up to 100 tag IDs
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问标签ID集合。一条策略最多支持100个内网访问标签ID
parameters.name: tag_ids

parameters.help_en:
The user group type for the internal network access policy. Valid values:

- **Normal**: Regular user group.

- **Custom**: Custom user group
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略的用户组类型。取值：
- **Normal**：普通用户组。
- **Custom**：自定义用户组
parameters.name: user_group_mode

parameters.help_en: The IDs of user groups associated with the internal network access policy. This parameter is required when UserGroupMode is set to Normal. This parameter is mutually exclusive with **CustomUserAttributes**. A single policy supports up to 10,000 user groups. You can update up to 2,000 user group IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略的用户组ID集合，当用户组类型为**Normal**时，必填。和自定义用户组集合互斥。单个策略的用户组最大支持10000个，单次修改的用户组ID数量最多2000个
parameters.name: user_group_ids

element_fields.help_en:
The type of the custom user attribute. Valid values:

- **username**: Username.

- **department**: Department.

- **email**: Email address.

- **telephone**: Phone number
element_fields.help_zh:
自定义用户组的类型。取值：
- **username**：用户名。
- **department**：部门。
- **email**：邮箱。
- **telephone**：手机
element_fields.name: user_group_type

element_fields.help_en:
The relation used to match the custom user attribute. Valid values:

- **Equal**: Equal to.

- **Unequal**: Not equal to
element_fields.help_zh:
自定义用户组的关系。取值：
- **Equal**：等于。
- **Unequal**：不等于
element_fields.name: relation

element_fields.help_en:
The value of the custom user attribute.

- If UserGroupType is **username**, this is the username. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), asterisks (\*), at signs (@), and spaces.

- If UserGroupType is **department**, this is the department name. Example: OU=Department 1,OU=SASE DingTalk.

- If UserGroupType is **email**, this is the email address. Example: username\@example.com.

- If UserGroupType is **telephone**, this is the phone number. Example: 13900001234
element_fields.help_zh:
自定义用户组属性的值。
- 当用户组类型为**username**时，表示用户名的值。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）、星号（*）、at（@）和空格。
- 当用户组类型为**department**时，表示部门的值。如：OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉。
- 当用户组类型为**email**时，表示邮箱的值。如：username@example.com。
- 当用户组类型为**telephone**时，表示手机的值。如：13900001234
element_fields.name: value

element_fields.help_en: The identity provider ID for the custom user attribute. This parameter is required when UserGroupType is **department**
element_fields.help_zh: 自定义用户组的身份源ID。当自定义用户组类型为**department**时，必填
element_fields.name: idp_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter specifies a collection of custom user groups for the private network access policy. It is required when the user group type is **Custom**. This collection is mutually exclusive with the user group ID collection, and you can specify a maximum of 10 custom user groups
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略的自定义用户组集合，当用户组类型为**Custom**时，必填。和用户组ID集合互斥。自定义用户组总数最多10个
parameters.name: custom_user_attributes

parameters.help_en:
The status of the internal network access policy. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enabled.

- **Disabled**: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略的状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The priority of the internal network access policy. Priority 1 is the highest. Valid values: 1 to 1000. The maximum value is the total number of internal network access policies minus 1
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略优先级。数字1表示优先级最高。取值：1~1000，最大值为内网访问策略总数减一
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The method used to update the internal network access policy. Valid values:

- **Cover** (default): Replace the existing application IDs, user group IDs, and custom user attributes with the values specified in **ApplicationIds**, **UserGroupIds**, and **CustomUserAttributes**.

- **Append**: Add the values specified in **ApplicationIds**, **UserGroupIds**, and **CustomUserAttributes** to the existing application IDs, user group IDs, and custom user attributes
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略的修改类型。取值：
- **Cover**（默认）：使用**ApplicationIds**、**UserGroupIds**、**CustomUserAttributes**参数的值覆盖原应用ID集合、用户组ID集合、自定义用户组集合。
- **Append**：在原应用ID集合、用户组ID集合、自定义用户组集合中分别增加**ApplicationIds**、**UserGroupIds**、**CustomUserAttributes**参数中输入的值
parameters.name: modify_type

parameters.help_zh: 安全基线策略的ID
parameters.name: device_attribute_id

parameters.help_en:
The action taken when a device does not meet the security baseline. Valid values:

- **Block**: Block access.

- **Observe**: Monitor access
parameters.help_zh:
不满足安全基线的执行策略。取值：

- **Observe**：观察
parameters.name: device_attribute_action

parameters.help_zh: 可信软件ID

parameters.help_zh: 可信进程组ID
parameters.name: trusted_process_group_ids

The status of the trusted process feature. Valid values:

- **Disabled**: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
可信进程开关状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭
parameters.name: trusted_process_status

parameters.help_en: The start time of the zero-trust policy's effective period, in seconds since the Unix epoch
parameters.help_zh: 零信任策略的生效起始时间，为秒级时间戳
parameters.name: valid_from

parameters.help_en: The end time of the zero-trust policy's effective period, in seconds since the Unix epoch
parameters.help_zh: 零信任策略的生效截止时间，为秒级时间戳
parameters.name: valid_until

parameters.help_en:

- **Disabled**: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
生效时间开关状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭
